prompt:
Subject: Floor of books and records

Main Figure: A 20-something woman lying on her back on a dark and warm wooden study floor surrounded by bookshelves, with a white pillow under her head, captured in a full-body vertical shot from directly above. The woman occupies the center of the screen diagonally from head to toe, with her head in the upper center, chest in the upper middle, black pleated skirt in the center, and crossed legs extending into the lower half. She turns her head to her own right, eyes closed, wearing large silver headphones. She holds a small black cassette player next to her head with her right hand, elbow bent. Her left arm is stretched long across the floor to the right side of the screen, with the fingertips of her left hand placed near the bottom edge of an open book. Her right leg is crossed over her left at the knee, with the right foot extending toward the lower left and the left foot toward the lower center.

Character/Expression: A short black bob with bangs reaching the eyebrows, thin strands along the cheeks, and slightly flipped-out ends. A relaxed profile with eyes closed, face tilted to her right, and lips slightly parted. Skin is warm light beige, eyebrows are thin dark brown, eyelids have light brown shadows, cheeks have a subtle flush, and lips are deep coral red. The headphones covering her ears have large silver circular housings, black cushions, and a silver headband, with a long black cable arching from the right side of her head to the floor. She wears a thin gold chain with a single small pendant around her neck and a delicate bracelet on her right wrist.

Clothing/Pose: Wears a white short-sleeved button-down shirt unbuttoned. Features a sharp collar, chest pocket, small white buttons, hem spreading to the sides, and clear natural wrinkles. Inside, she wears a delicate cream-colored lace bralette, showing thin shoulder straps, floral lace, and a thin edge under the bust. The bottom is a charcoal-colored high-waisted pleated mini skirt with a fine check pattern, showing wide folds, a waist seam, and a fan-shaped hem. She wears white ribbed socks above the ankles and glossy black leather loafers. The right hand holds the cassette player naturally, with the thumb and four fingers on the edges. The left hand rests relaxed on the floor, naturally connecting the crossed legs, knees, ankles, and shoes.

Background/Lighting: The entire floor is warm honey-colored wood grain, with thin board seams running diagonally. At the top and upper right, dark wooden bookshelves are lined up at right angles, packed with numerous dark, white, and blue-green books, with a large pile of books on the floor in the upper center. A low wooden desk enters diagonally from the top left, holding a round black desk lamp, a black cup, a large book with photos and illustrations, and a blue book. Large open books are placed at the bottom left and right center, showing fine text and dark photos/color illustrations (text is illegible). A black record with an orange center label is at the bottom left, and a record with a light green center label is at the bottom center-right. A wooden and beige portable record player sits diagonally at the bottom right with the lid open, playing a black record with a white label. Black cables from the headphones and player cross the floor in long curves, weaving between the woman and the books. The desk lamp at the top left and warm light from above create diagonal shadows on the pillow, face, shirt, abdomen, skirt, legs, and floor, leaving the depths of the bookshelves in deep shadow.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 position, a full-body photo captured from a flat arrangement of the person and surrounding objects using a bird's-eye view camera fixed directly above the floor. High resolution for the face, cassette player, clothes, hands, and records, with only the back of the bookshelves slightly dark and soft.

Texture/Style: A high-resolution realistic indoor editorial photo. Honey-colored wood, cream, white, charcoal, black, and dull silver as base colors, with orange and light green record labels as small accents. Precise depiction of skin texture, hair, cotton shirt, fine lace, check weave, sock ribs, loafer gloss, fabric pillow, old book covers, record grooves, and wood scratches. Warm lighting and deep shadows with subtle film grain create a calm atmosphere of a night study and analog music.
